covers.cover: Just as the world economy was recovering
covers.prediction: Trouble in the oil region could kill the young world recovery
covers.what_happened: Oil stayed costly and Europe hurt, but world growth still reached about 4 percent.

covers.cover: The man who screwed an entire country
covers.prediction: Berlusconi's years in power had badly damaged Italy (a judgment)
covers.what_happened: He was forced to resign five months later. Italy's economy stayed weak for years.

covers.prediction: The Berlusconi era was finally over
covers.what_happened: He resigned the same week and never became prime minister again.
